hint.import: You can import an event model trained on swings you labelled yourself (a .json and a .bin file).
hint.import._context: Developer section of Settings, under the event-model import controls.
error.no_crypto: This browser cannot compute file fingerprints, so the model cannot be checked.
error.json: The model description file (.json) is not valid.
error.format: The model format should be {want}; this file is {got}.
error.feature_version: The model uses feature version {got}; this app uses {want}.
error.bin: The weights file (.bin) could not be read.
error.bin_size: The weights file is {got} B; the description says {want} B.
error.hash: The weights file fingerprint does not match ({got}… ≠ {want}… in the description).
error.digest: Could not compute the weights file fingerprint: {detail}
error.not_checked: The model did not pass the checks, so it was not imported.
error.golden_empty: The reference results in the description have no test cases.
error.golden_len: Reference case {name} has the wrong output length.
error.golden_diff: Reference case {name} differs by {diff}, more than the allowed {tol}.
error.golden_argmax: Reference case {name} picks a different event in {n} frames.
error.card_missing: The model has no model card, so its training data cannot be confirmed.
error.card_third_party: This model was trained on a public dataset that does not allow commercial use, so it cannot be imported.
error.card_training: The model card does not list its training data, or uses data other than your labels and synthetic swings.
error.card_holdout: The model card has no results on your own held-out labels, so it cannot be imported.
status.research: Using the research model bundled in this development build.
status.rules: Swing events are detected by the built-in rules.
status.back_builtin: You can go back to the built-in rules.
status.no_back: There is no previous model to go back to.
rollback.none: There is no previous model to go back to.
gate.passed: This model passed the threshold on your held-out swings and is used for the angles it covers.
gate.not_passed: This model has not passed the threshold on your held-out swings yet, so the built-in rules are still used.
